newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares well-traded again, index gains.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares well-traded again, index gains.

text.p: Trading was lively again on the Estonian stock exchange on Wednesday with Savings Bank accounting for the largest volume.
Main list total trade reached 57.7 million kroons and Savings Bank turned over a big 23.7 million kroons, dealers said. The stock exchange index rose 2.84 percent to 145.97.
Savings bank closed at 61.95 kroons versus 62.55 kroons.
"One block of 100,000 shares and slightly smaller packets were sold but the source is unknown," said Riho Talumaa, dealer from Talinvest investment house, speaking of Savings Bank.
Market leader Hansapank was the second most active on turnover of 9.6 million kroons and ended down a kroon at 143.25.
"Trading is very active despite there being no corporate news published recently. Investors are preparing for next year ahead of Christmas," said Talumaa.
Shares in Forekspank had turnover of 8.8 million kroons and closed at 102.30 kroons versus 97.50.
Union Bank saw trade of 6.7 million kroons and ended higher at 31.36 kroons against 26.95.
Over-the-counter volume on the free market was 7.2 million kroons as the Rakvere meat processer turned over some 2.5 million kroons and closed at nine kroons versus 7.80.
Shares in the Norma plastics maker traded 2.3 million kroons of stock and it also closed higher at 35.35 kroons versus 35 kroons on Tuesday.
